hints.title: Grouping by Equidistant Pivot Point
hints.text: Fix one point as the central vertex. Count how many other points lie at each distinct squared Euclidean distance from it.

hints.title: Permutations of Equidistant Point Pairs
hints.text: If count points share the exact same distance from the central vertex, they contribute count * (count - 1) ordered pairs to the total.

hints.title: Iterating Each Point as Center
hints.text: For each point i, map squared distance (x1 - x2)^2 + (y1 - y2)^2 to frequency. For each frequency val in the map, add val * (val - 1) to answer.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal quadratic O(N^2) time and linear O(N) auxiliary space per pivot point.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all triplets of points takes cubic O(N^3) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Distance frequency dictionary counts permutations in linear time per point.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should compute squared distances to maintain integer precision and avoid floating point inaccuracies.
